historical_mutant_claim: Reviewer at 660d8d2 reported that substituting an unbounded per-event decode ceiling left the full suite green. This audit did not rerun that mutation on current main.
current_findings: Production authenticateCheckpointCandidateInto verifies the checkpoint SSH signature before validateCompactCheckpointInto.
validateCompactCheckpointInto and streamCheckpointCandidate pass the genesis ceiling minus the verified envelope size to readCompactCheckpointEvent.

decodeCompactCheckpoint still preallocates Events using the manifest EventCount and calls readCompactCheckpointEvent with ^uint64(0); decodeCheckpoint and decodeCompactCheckpoint have no callers outside their mutual call and test files.

Current combined-ceiling tests call validateCheckpoint (legacy path) and payloadWithinCeiling; the only direct readCompactCheckpointEvent tests use an unbounded ceiling to isolate attachment-count checks. This source inspection is not a claim that every current indirect test survives a ceiling mutation.
The old attachment-count writer/reader mismatch is already addressed by maxCheckpointAttachments and TestCompactCheckpointWriterRefusesAboveDecoderCeiling. Do not reopen it.
limits: No fresh test execution, security verdict, or 500k performance measurement in this audit.
